# Graysmith Labs

> Graysmith Labs is an independent software studio in the United States run by Ramsey Graysmith. It builds and publishes iPhone apps and takes contract engineering work for web, mobile and desktop.

Contact: ramsey@graysmithlabs.com

## Apps

### Drift

Drift is a free white noise and sleep sounds app for iPhone and iPad that works offline, even on a plane: white noise, rain, ocean, stream, fan and a 432 Hz tone are free, with a sleep timer and sound that keeps playing with the screen locked. It is a free alternative to Calm for masking snoring or traffic, and Premium at $1.99 a month, with a free first week, adds pink noise, green noise, thunder, forest, night, fire, wind, cafe, 174 Hz and 528 Hz tones and Alpha, Theta and Delta binaural beats, and removes ads.

* Pricing: Free with six sounds and ads. Premium is $1.99 a month and unlocks all nineteen sounds with no ads; eligible new subscribers get a free week. Premium sounds can be previewed for 30 seconds a day.
* Platforms: iPhone and iPad
* Best for: falling asleep faster with white noise or rain; masking snoring, traffic or noisy neighbors; sleeping on planes or anywhere without signal
* Page: https://graysmithlabs.com/apps/drift.html
* App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758258891

### SignSnap

SignSnap is a free iPhone and iPad app to sign a PDF or scan and sign a paper form, such as a lease, offer letter or permission slip, with no account and no uploads: draw or type your signature, place it on the line, stamp the date and share the signed PDF. It is a simple alternative to DocuSign when you only need to sign one document yourself.

* Pricing: Free for the first 2 signed documents, then one rewarded ad unlocks one more signing. Premium is weekly, monthly or yearly with no ads and no limit, with a free week for new subscribers.
* Platforms: iPhone and iPad
* Best for: signing a PDF on iPhone for free; signing one document without a DocuSign account; signing a lease, offer letter or permission slip from a phone; people who do not want to make an account or upload documents to a cloud service; replacing print, sign and scan
* Page: https://graysmithlabs.com/apps/signsnap.html
* App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759199184

### CelebriDay

CelebriDay is an iPhone and iPad app that tells you what national day it is today, every day of the year: a morning notification names today's holiday, and each of its 700 plus observances, from National Pizza Day to World Emoji Day, has a fun fact and a card to share on social media. Today and tomorrow are free in the app, and a free list of national days by month, with every date checked, is on the web at graysmithlabs.com/holidays/.

* Pricing: Free with ads: today and tomorrow, every holiday's fun fact, sharing and the 8 AM daily note. Premium, monthly or yearly with a free week for new subscribers, opens every other day of the calendar, favorites, choosing the note time and removes ads.
* Platforms: iPhone and iPad
* Best for: finding out what national day it is today; teachers, offices and teams looking for fun national days to celebrate at work; social media managers planning posts around national days; daily conversation starters and fun facts
* Page: https://graysmithlabs.com/apps/celebriday.html
* App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760971240

### SayBright

SayBright is a daily affirmations app for iPhone that helps you build a daily affirmation habit with five free affirmations a day, a daily reminder and streaks, from 340 affirmations in ten categories such as confidence, gratitude and self love. Premium ($0.99 a month or $9.99 a year) adds every category with no daily limit, affirmations on your lock screen and home screen as widgets, affirmations you record in your own voice, and no ads.

* Pricing: Free plan: five affirmations a day, the full Confidence category, previews of the other nine categories, streaks, reminders, share cards and your own written affirmations. Premium is $0.99 a month or $9.99 a year with a free week for eligible new subscribers, and unlocks every category with no daily limit, widgets, voice recordings and no ads.
* Platforms: iPhone
* Best for: building a daily affirmation habit; positive affirmations on the lock screen; morning routines and gratitude practice; people who want a low cost affirmation app
* Page: https://graysmithlabs.com/apps/saybright.html
* App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6767243151

### BlitzTap

BlitzTap is a free reaction time game for iPhone and iPad for anyone who wants to test and improve their reflexes in rounds of a minute or two: a target shape appears and you tap its match in a grid before the timer runs out, in Classic, Time Attack, Zen or a Daily Challenge. It is free with ads, with no energy timers and nothing pay to win; a one time purchase removes ads.

* Pricing: Free with ads. A one time purchase removes ads. No subscription.
* Platforms: iPhone and iPad
* Best for: testing and training reaction time; quick games to play in one minute; a free reflex game with no energy timers or pay to win; focus and visual search practice; a daily challenge to compare with friends
* Page: https://graysmithlabs.com/apps/blitztap.html
* App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759490849

### TubTender

TubTender is a hot tub water care and chemical calculator app for iPhone, for bromine or chlorine tubs: tap the colors on your test strip, scan the labels of the chemicals you own, and it shows how much of each to add for your tub size, in the right order, with a countdown until the water is safe to soak. The test and dose plan is free with no account, and it is on the App Store.

* Pricing: Free test, dose plan, reminders, the cloudy and foamy water guides and your last 5 tests. Premium monthly or yearly adds trend charts, full history and every fix it guide, with a free week to try it.
* Platforms: iPhone
* Best for: new hot tub owners who do not know how much chemical to add; bromine or chlorine hot tubs; fixing cloudy, foamy or smelly hot tub water; keeping a test schedule
* Page: https://graysmithlabs.com/apps/tubtender.html
* App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6820791512

### Tallyhand

Tallyhand is an iPhone invoice, estimate and receipt maker for one person service businesses such as lawn care, house cleaning and handyman work: you type or dictate the job in one sentence, it builds the line items and total, shares a professional PDF, and reminds you on the due date and when a client is late. The first 3 documents are free with no account, and it is on the App Store.

* Pricing: First 3 invoices or estimates free with every feature. Premium monthly or yearly, with a free week to try it, adds unlimited documents, your logo on every PDF and income reports with a CSV export.
* Platforms: iPhone
* Best for: lawn care and landscaping invoices; house cleaning invoices; handyman and contractor estimates; turning a paid invoice into a receipt; knowing which clients still owe you
* Page: https://graysmithlabs.com/apps/tallyhand.html
* App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6827360818

## Studio services

Graysmith Labs is a founder led software studio in the United States, working with clients worldwide, that designs and builds iOS and Android apps (React Native and Expo, or Swift), web apps, backends and AI features for companies, takes apps through App Store review and launch, and offers a fixed price app audit for $499 (written report in 5 business days plus a 30 minute walkthrough call). Every project starts with a free scoping call, then a written plan and a fixed quote; contract engineering is billed weekly or monthly. Proof is public: the studio publishes its own iPhone apps (Drift, SignSnap, CelebriDay, SayBright, BlitzTap, TubTender) and built the Valentine Tide storefront.

* iOS and Android app development: One React Native and Expo codebase for both stores, or native Swift, through App Store review and launch.
* Web app and site development: Web apps and sites from a marketing page to a full product with accounts, payments and dashboards.
* Backend and cloud engineering: APIs, webhooks, background jobs and serverless infrastructure.
* AI features and automation: Assistants, search, summaries, on device features and agents inside a product or its operations.
* Subscriptions and ads setup: Paywalls, free trials, RevenueCat entitlements and AdMob with App Tracking Transparency.
* Contract engineering: A senior engineer inside a client team on weekly or monthly terms.
* Fixed price app audit: $499. A review of an app, its codebase, its paywall and its App Store listing, with a written report of what to fix first in 5 business days and a 30 minute walkthrough call.
* Page: https://graysmithlabs.com/services/

## Starter kit

Graysmith Labs is preparing an Expo starter kit for subscription and ad supported iPhone apps, taken from the code behind its App Store apps: a RevenueCat paywall with trial eligibility checks, AdMob with App Tracking Transparency and capped interstitials, PostHog analytics events, App Store screenshot automation with Guideline 2.3.7 checks, EAS build, submit and listings, guard hooks and Claude Code subagents. It is not for sale yet and has no price; there is a waitlist.

* Page: https://graysmithlabs.com/kit/

## Free tools

* What holiday is it today: https://graysmithlabs.com/holidays/ (verified daily observances, from the team behind CelebriDay)
* Hot tub chemical calculator: https://graysmithlabs.com/hot-tub-calculator/ (exact doses in order for bromine or chlorine tubs, using the TubTender app's engine)
* White noise generator: https://graysmithlabs.com/white-noise/ (white, pink or brown noise in the browser, from the team behind Drift)
* Sleep calculator: https://graysmithlabs.com/sleep-calculator/ (bedtimes or wake up times in whole 90 minute sleep cycles, from the team behind Drift)
* Signature maker: https://graysmithlabs.com/signature-maker/ (draw or type a signature and download a transparent PNG, nothing uploaded, from the team behind SignSnap)
* Affirmation of the day: https://graysmithlabs.com/affirmations/ (a new confidence affirmation daily with a share card, from the team behind SayBright)
* Invoice generator: https://graysmithlabs.com/invoice-generator/ (fill in your business, client and items and download a PDF invoice, no sign up, nothing uploaded, from the team behind Tallyhand)
* Reaction time test: https://graysmithlabs.com/reaction-time-test/ (five rounds, tap when the box turns green, average and best in milliseconds, from the team behind BlitzTap)

## Guides

* [How to sign a PDF on iPhone](https://graysmithlabs.com/guides/sign-pdf-on-iphone.html): How to sign a PDF on iPhone for free: use Markup in the Files app, or scan and sign with SignSnap. Step by step, no printer and no account.
* [How to fill and sign a lease on your phone](https://graysmithlabs.com/guides/fill-and-sign-lease-on-phone.html): Fill in and sign a rental lease on iPhone: get it as a PDF, type into the blanks, initial and sign each page, and send it back. No printer needed.
* [Cloudy hot tub water: why it happens and how to fix it](https://graysmithlabs.com/guides/cloudy-hot-tub-water.html): Why is my hot tub water cloudy? Usually low sanitizer, high pH or alkalinity, or a dirty filter. Test, balance, shock and rinse the filter, in that order.
* [Sleep sounds that work offline on a plane](https://graysmithlabs.com/guides/sleep-sounds-offline-on-a-plane.html): Yes, you can play sleep sounds offline on a plane. Use an app whose sounds ship inside it, test in airplane mode before you fly, and set a sleep timer.
* [How to sign one document for free without DocuSign](https://graysmithlabs.com/guides/sign-one-document-without-docusign.html): Need to sign just one document? Three free ways to sign a PDF on iPhone with no DocuSign account or subscription, and when DocuSign still fits.
* [Weird holidays in November 2026](https://graysmithlabs.com/guides/weird-holidays-november.html): Weird and fun holidays in November 2026, from Deviled Egg Day to Red Planet Day, with each date checked and ideas to celebrate them at work.
* [How do I put affirmations on my iPhone lock screen?](https://graysmithlabs.com/guides/affirmations-on-iphone-lock-screen.html): Put affirmations on your iPhone Lock Screen for free with a wallpaper or a daily reminder, or add a widget that shows a new affirmation through the day.
* [Weird holidays in December 2026](https://graysmithlabs.com/guides/weird-holidays-december.html): Weird and fun holidays in December 2026, from Pretend to Be a Time Traveler Day to Festivus, with each date checked and ideas for the office.
